description.value: The Thirsty Duck is a long-established neighbourhood pub in New Westminster that has been serving locals since 1981, now under new ownership. It offers a full sit-down menu with daily themed specials, pool tables, and comprehensive sports coverage including NHL and NFL packages. Both indoor and outdoor seating are available, making it a social stop for groups passing through the New Westminster area.
